findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT- There were observed to be raw shell eggs on a bucket of pickles in the double-door cooler. CORRECTED- The eggs were moved to the bottom shelf of the cooler. Proper storage order was discussed. Ensure that food is protected from contamination during preparation, holding, storage, and display.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: SECOND REPEAT- The gasket on the double door cooler is observed to be cracked and needs to be replaced. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that equipment is maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of repair: 

1. THIRD REPEAT- The caulking between the wall and the triple sink is observed to be in a state of disrepair. Ensure that this is repaired and is made to be smooth and easily cleanable. 
2. THIRD REPEAT- The cove base in the kitchen under the fire extinguisher to the right of the triple sink is observed to be coming off. Ensure that this is sealed back to the wall. 
Due to these two above violations being third repeats, a follow up has been scheduled for 12/1/2026 to ensure that they have been corrected. 

3. SECOND REPEAT- The wall above the mop sink basin in the mop closet has a hole in it and is observed to be in disrepair. Ensure that this wall is repaired and is made to be smooth and easily cleanable. 

Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair. Ensure that all repairs are made to be smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
